title: The LORD Challenges Job: Leviathan

questions.question: Can you draw out Leviathan with a what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:1 (ESV): "Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook or press down his tongue with a cord?"

questions.question: Will he make many pleas to you? Will he speak to you what kind of words?
questions.explanation: Job 41:3 (ESV): "Will he make many pleas to you? Will he speak to you soft words?"

questions.question: Will he make a covenant with you to take him for your what forever?
questions.explanation: Job 41:4 (ESV): "Will he make a covenant with you to take him for your servant forever?"

questions.question: Will you play with him as with a what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:5 (ESV): "Will you play with him as with a bird, or will you put him on a leash for your girls?"

questions.question: Lay your hands on him; remember the battle—you will not do what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:8 (ESV): "Lay your hands on him; remember the battle—you will not do it again!"

questions.question: Who then is he that can stand before whom?
questions.explanation: Job 41:10 (ESV): "No one is so fierce that he dares to stir him up. Who then is he that can stand before me?"

questions.question: Who has given to me that I should repay him? Whatever is under the whole heaven is whose?
questions.explanation: Job 41:11 (ESV): "Who has given to me that I should repay him? Whatever is under the whole heaven is mine."

questions.question: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who would come near him with a double what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:13 (ESV): "Who can strip off his outer garment? Who would come near him with a double bridle?"

questions.question: His back is made of rows of what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:15 (ESV): "His back is made of rows of shields, shut up closely as with a seal."

questions.question: One is so near to another that no what can come between them?
questions.explanation: Job 41:16 (ESV): "One is so near to another that no air can come between them."

questions.question: His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:18 (ESV): "His sneezings flash forth light, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the dawn."

questions.question: Out of his mouth go flaming torches; sparks of what leap forth?
questions.explanation: Job 41:19 (ESV): "Out of his mouth go flaming torches; sparks of fire leap forth."

questions.question: Out of his nostrils comes smoke, as from a boiling pot and burning what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:20 (ESV): "Out of his nostrils comes smoke, as from a boiling pot and burning rushes."

questions.question: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid; at the crashing they are what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:25 (ESV): "When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid; at the crashing they are beside themselves."

questions.question: He makes the deep boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of what?
questions.explanation: Job 41:31 (ESV): "He makes the deep boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of ointment."

key_verse_text: Who has given to me that I should repay him? Whatever is under the whole heaven is mine.
